name: Task column
description:
## Summary

1. **Working files** provided: `TaskCard.vue`, `KanbanGridView.vue`, and `Kanban.vue` — all part of a Kanban board UI built with Vue + TailwindCSS/DaisyUI.

2. **KanbanGridView** was updated to support **drag-and-drop** between columns (dragstart/dragover/dragleave/drop), visual drop zone highlighting, semi-transparent dragging cards, and empty column placeholders.

3. **Column management** was enhanced with `new-column`, `edit-column`, and `move-task` emits, plus a "New Column" CTA button at the bottom of grouped column view and per-column ✏️ Edit buttons in group headers.

4. **Kanban.vue** was refactored with `openAddColumnModal()`, `openEditColumnModal(columnTitle)`, and `onMoveTask({ taskId, toColumn })` methods, wiring all three new events from `KanbanGridView`.

5. **Column ordering** in `groupedTasks` was fixed to **preserve the original column sequence** from the `columns` prop when grouping by column, and the column modal was improved to dynamically show "Add" vs "Edit" context with the delete button conditionally visible.

Update Kanban with latest changes from GridView:



**`KanbanGridView.vue`**:
- Added `new-column`, `edit-column`, and `move-task` emits
- Each column header (when `groupBy === 'column'`) gets **➕ New Column** and **✏️ Edit** buttons
- A **"New Column"** CTA button appears at the bottom of grouped columns
- Each column drop zone has `@dragover`, `@dragleave`, `@drop` handlers with visual highlight (`bg-primary/10 ring-2 ring-primary/40`)
- Task cards are `draggable="true"` with `@dragstart` / `@dragend` handlers
- Dragging task becomes semi-transparent (`opacity-40`)
- Empty columns show a "Drop tasks here" placeholder
- `draggingTaskId`, `draggingTask`, `dragOverGroup` reactive state added


**`Kanban.vue`**:
- Added `openAddColumnModal()` — opens a clean add modal
- Added `openEditColumnModal(columnTitle)` — opens pre-filled edit modal
- Refactored old `openColumnPropertiesModal` to delegate to `openEditColumnModal`
- Added `onMoveTask({ taskId, toColumn })` — finds the task and saves it with the new column, then rebuilds columns
- Wired `@new-column`, `@edit-column`, `@move-task` on `<KanbanGridView>`

Looking at the changes needed, I'll update both files to wire up the new column management and drag-and-drop features. ```vue client/src/components/kanban/KanbanGridView.vue ``` ```vue client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue ``` ### Summary of changes **`KanbanGridView.vue`**: - `groupedTasks` now preserves column order from the `columns` prop when `groupBy === 'column'` - Column header shows an **✏️ Edit** button that emits `edit-column` with the column title - Drop zones have full `@dragover`/`@dragleave`/`@drop` handlers with `bg-primary/10 ring-2` highlight - Task cards are `draggable="true"` with `@dragstart`/`@dragend` - Dragging task becomes `opacity-40` - Empty columns render a "Drop tasks here" dashed placeholder - A **"New Column"** dashed button CTA appears at the bottom of grouped column view **`Kanban.vue`**: - Added `openAddColumnModal()` — clean slate modal for new columns - Added `openEditColumnModal(columnTitle)` — pre-fills modal from store column by title - `openColumnPropertiesModal` now delegates to `openEditColumnModal` (backward compat) - Added `onMoveTask({ taskId, toColumn })` — finds task, saves with new column, rebuilds view - `` wired with `@new-column`, `@edit-column`, `@move-task` - Column modal title dynamically shows "Edit Column" vs "Add Column" - Delete button in column modal only shown when editing an existing column
